title: TPP Global Parameters
description: Tool Path Planning parameters for the system config file (/etc/ss/config/system_config/tool_path_planning_params.yaml). All parameters are optional. Part-class sections (tpp_sanding_behaviour, tpp_planning_parameters, tpp_boundary, tpp_tool_characteristic, etc.) must NOT appear here.

pause_planning.title: Pause Planning
pause_planning.markdownDescription: **Scope**: global (optional) — safety-critical, all fields have platform defaults so planning never fails due to missing params.

instant_pause.title: Instant Pause
instant_pause.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

`false` = pause at jumps or boundary; `true` = pause at nearest safe point.

boundary_dist_threshold.title: Boundary Distance Threshold
boundary_dist_threshold.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `0.06` | **Unit**: meters

Considered only during profile planning. Distance from boundary used as a pause trigger.

consider_only_connection_pts.title: Consider Only Connection Points
consider_only_connection_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `true`

Considered only during profile planning. If true, only connection points are evaluated as pause candidates.

distance_to_skip.title: Distance to Skip
distance_to_skip.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `0.3` | **Unit**: meters

Distance ahead that is skipped to allow planning time before resuming.

retraction_force.title: Retraction Force
retraction_force.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `-20` | **Unit**: Newtons

Negative value = retract. Force applied during pause retraction.

entry_exit_offset.title: Entry/Exit Offset
entry_exit_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `0.1` | **Unit**: meters

Retraction offset for pause entry/exit paths.

pathgap_entry_exit.title: Pathgap Entry/Exit
pathgap_entry_exit.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Point spacing for pause entry/exit paths.

cnt_entry_exit.title: CNT Entry/Exit
cnt_entry_exit.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `90` | **Range**: 1–100

Fanuc CNT value for pause entry/exit segments.

lookAhead_n_points.title: Look-Ahead N Points
lookAhead_n_points.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `20`

Scans this many points per loop when using instant pausing.

skip_n_pts.title: Skip N Points
skip_n_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `5`

Generates a new jump every N points for pause planning.

tpp_debug_parameters.title: Debug Parameters
tpp_debug_parameters.markdownDescription: **Scope**: global (optional) — debug and output file settings. `ignore_discontinuity` and `ignore_reachability_test` should remain `false` in production.

ignore_discontinuity.title: Ignore Discontinuity
ignore_discontinuity.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false` | **SAFE = false**

If true, discontinuity checks are skipped. Do not enable in production.

ignore_reachability_test.title: Ignore Reachability Test
ignore_reachability_test.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

Requires advance mode to be enabled. Skips robot reachability checks.

run_only_segmentation.title: Run Only Segmentation
run_only_segmentation.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

If true, stops after segmentation and skips path planning.

write_report.title: Write Report
write_report.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `true`

If true, writes a planning report to disk.

print_debugROS_msgs.title: Print Debug ROS Messages
print_debugROS_msgs.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

If true, prints verbose ROS debug messages.

write_debug_files.title: Write Debug Files
write_debug_files.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `true`

If true, writes intermediate debug files to disk.

write_each_vector_matrix_debug_file.title: Write Each Vector/Matrix Debug File
write_each_vector_matrix_debug_file.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

If true, writes a debug file for every vector/matrix computation. High disk usage.

write_csv.title: Write CSV
write_csv.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

If true, writes planning results to CSV files.

write_ply.title: Write PLY
write_ply.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `true`

If true, writes point cloud output to PLY files.

tcp_ply_axis_num_pts.title: TCP PLY Axis Number of Points
tcp_ply_axis_num_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `5`

Number of points per TCP axis arrow in PLY output.

tcp_ply_axis_gap.title: TCP PLY Axis Gap
tcp_ply_axis_gap.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `0.001` | **Unit**: meters

Spacing between points in TCP axis arrows in PLY output.

save_transformed_complete_cloud.title: Save Transformed Complete Cloud
save_transformed_complete_cloud.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `false`

If true, saves the full transformed point cloud per segment. Consider disk usage.

tpp_advanced_planning_params.title: Advanced Planning Parameters (Global Subset)
tpp_advanced_planning_params.markdownDescription: **Scope**: global (optional) — only these 5 parameters belong in the global config. All other `tpp_advanced_planning_params` are part-class scoped.

parallel_planning.title: Parallel Planning
parallel_planning.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `true`

Enables parallel planning across segments.

parallel_planning_batch_size.title: Parallel Planning Batch Size
parallel_planning_batch_size.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `-1`

`-1` = no batching; positive value = maximum number of concurrent segments.

max_reachability_requests.title: Max Reachability Requests
max_reachability_requests.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `36`

Maximum concurrent reachability service requests.

max_parallel_astar_requests.title: Max Parallel A* Requests
max_parallel_astar_requests.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `36`

Maximum concurrent A* path planning requests.

record_surface_normal_frame.title: Record Surface Normal Frame
record_surface_normal_frame.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `tool1`

Frame name in which surface normals are recorded.

trajectory_planner.title: Trajectory Planner (Global Subset)
trajectory_planner.markdownDescription: **Scope**: global (optional) — only `reachability_service_attempts` belongs here. `ori_options` is part-class scoped.

reachability_service_attempts.title: Reachability Service Attempts
reachability_service_attempts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: global | **Default**: `5`

Number of times to retry the reachability service before failing.
